_note: Opening line per guide (slide 1 title + caption opener). Founder 2026-10-07: no score, no flat 'it's a go'; dramatic like Kanishk Gupta's films (style study .scrapes/youtube, 11 videos): open on the thing, name the place LAST, no numbers. Every line must rest on a fact in the destination's fact pack (why_special or the month verdict) - quoted beside it in _basis.

srinagar.10: The emperors built these gardens for exactly this light. Srinagar, in October.

mussoorie.10: The hill station that introduced generations of Indians to the mountains. Mussoorie, in October.

nainital.10: An emerald lake ringed by hills, under the clearest skies of the year. Nainital.

kasol.10: Golden light on the Parvati, clear views all the way to Kheerganga. Kasol.

hyderabad.10: Bathukamma and Dussehra turn the old bazaars into pure colour. Hyderabad, in October.

spiti-valley.10: The last window before snow seals this valley for the winter. Spiti.

dharamshala.10: No cricket ground anywhere has mountains like these behind fine leg. Dharamshala.

tirupati.10: More pilgrims than the Vatican and Mecca combined climb to one hill temple. Tirupati.

araku-valley.10: A train through dozens of tunnels, and at the end, coffee country. Araku Valley.

mawlynnong.10: Bamboo dustbins on every path, in the village once named Asia's cleanest. Mawlynnong.

mawphlang.10: In this forest, nothing leaves. Not a leaf, not a pebble. Mawphlang.

srisailam.10: A Jyotirlinga and a Shakti Peetha side by side, deep in tiger country. Srisailam.

tirthan-valley.10: The Himachal you imagined, before you saw the real Manali. Tirthan Valley.

delhi.10: The tomb that taught the Taj how to look, under clear October skies. Delhi.

manali.10: Golden poplars, crisp days, and the road to Spiti and Lahaul starts here. Manali.

rishikesh.10: One river, two towns, and in October the rafting routes are open. Rishikesh.
